restriction_review.scope: Twenty-five missing compartmented Trio jewelry bodies: five metal families and five shapes each. All25 rendered primary output IDs, literal four-input formulas, independent numeric trivials, jewelry yield1, tool/mold success returns and tool-only failure returns match retained source. Enchanted Temporite Bar and both selected exact portable kit identities also directly observed; earlier explicit ingredient identities reused.
restriction_review.historical: Maintained EQTC SoD Jewelcraft category421 directly lists these bodies. min_expansion15/max-1 is a labelled SoD category reconstruction floor, not proof of exact earliest introduction or immutable May2013 fields. Existing native item identities/fields preserved; no modern-profile normalization or invented item records.
restriction_review.quantity: One physical nonstackable uncharged jewelry output, native maxcharges0/stackable0, successcount1. Four physical input units. Trio Setting Tool1 returns on both success and failure. Shape-specific Mold1 returns on success only and is consumed on failure, as explicitly listed. Success roles include jewelry, tool and mold; no mold failure return or charge maximum invented. Salvage0 on returned tools/molds; ordinary consumed material salvage equals component count.
restriction_review.containers: Select one explicitly listed bag for each body.24 bind Collapsible Jeweler Kit17187 primary7337; Dwerium Ring omits that kit and binds Reinforced Jeweler Kit62480 primary10816. Both exact current bagtype20/six slots/LARGE capacity fit full four inputs and sizes. Four Gold bodies omit Reinforced; their selected Collapsible route respects that omission. Other kit links not inferred from capacity or siblings.
restriction_review.actor: Ordinary JewelryMaking68. Source omits mandatory book, minimum skill and race/class manufacturing restrictions: minimum0/must_learn0/book0/quest0/enabled1/nofail0 labelled policies. Ingredient enchantment/acquisition requirements are not new manufacturing actor gates. No core edits or native acceptance.
restriction_review.preservation: 41 exact18-field native dependencies,37fresh/4reused. Zero current full-input/name matches.107 current positive-success output-use peers/533 exact entries, including returned tools/molds, are captured and guarded unchanged across all skills/states. New IDs/full entry multisets/counts/learned references guarded. No existing recipe/item/quest/core/player mutations.
restriction_review.execution: Source artifacts for normal publication and exact one-use coordinator SQL GO. Named count contract, no rehearsal/tests/build/runtime campaign.
